title: Transitivity of bounded reaching
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and let $c_0,c_1,c_2,c$ be configurations on the same input, with register $r$ and integer bound $L$. If $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ and $c_1$ reaches $c_2$, each relative to $c,r,L$ with the register head staying between $-1$ and $L$ at every intermediate time, then $c_0$ reaches $c_2$ with the same bound and relative to the same reference configuration and register.
hypotheses_covered: $c_0$ reaches $c_1$ relative to $c,r,L$ with all intermediate register-head positions in $[-1,L]$
$c_1$ reaches $c_2$ relative to $c,r,L$ with all intermediate register-head positions in $[-1,L]$
